newsitem.title: USA: Nebraska fed cattle market at standstill - trade.
newsitem.headline: Nebraska fed cattle market at standstill - trade.

text.p: Nebraska feedlot cattle market near midday on Friday was at a standstill following active sales this week that sold out most of the the showlist, market sources said.
Sales this week totalled close to 81,000 head. The showlist was estimated near 77,000 head earlier in the week.
Fed cattle sold mostly at $110.00 per cwt on a dressed basis, although there were a few that sold at $111.000 on Wednesday, the sources said.
Next week's showlist was seen unchanged to slightly larger than this week, they said.
